h1.title: After the one-click correction, suggestions from the second ASR engine are labelled 「按母本改成」 in the row detail panel
h1.scenario: Teacher runs 🔍 自动查找 (or prepare auto-checks), then 📝 一键全部文字校正. On a row the program says it is unsure about (e.g. the other engine heard 「同事」 for 「同时」, which the standard library does not cover), she clicks the row to listen and decide.
h1.actual: Before the one-click the panel reads 「识别 A（现在的文字）… / 识别 B（建议改成）…」. After it, the same unsure guess from the other engine is shown as 「现在的文字：… / 按母本改成：区别在于我们需要同事给出键和值。」. This credits a guess the program refused to auto-apply to the teacher's own mother library, which she has been told to trust (「以你的母本标准库为准」), so she is nudged into adopting a wrong word.
h1.expected: Use 「按母本改成」 only when every suggested change comes from the standard library or mother text. For suggestions from the other ASR engine, or a mix, keep a neutral label such as 「建议改成（另一个识别引擎听到的）」.
h1.evidence: app.py:2838 `from_tr = sus.get("src") == "transcript"` → app.py:2845 `_render_diff(text, alt, info["red"], from_tr)` → app.py:1311 `render_diff_html(text, alt, spans, label_b="按母本改成")`. transcript_fix.py:1322-1333: with only auto results left (`what="kept_auto"`, line 1343), the edits are still `edits_keep` from the other engine, and the result is stored with `"src": "transcript"`. Repro output: before: 「识别 B（建议改成）： 区别在于我们需要同 事 给出键和值。」; after (unsure=1, fixes=0, src=transcript, ref=None): 「按母本改成： 区别在于我们需要同 事 给出键和值。」
h1.fix: In merge_with_auto, record where each suggestion came from (for example `sus["auto_edits"]`, or `sus["from"]` = mother/auto/mixed). In on_clip_pick, pass label_b="按母本改成" only when every edit is from the mother or library; otherwise use the default 识别 A/B labels or 「建议改成」.

verdict.evidence:
I reproduced this with （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/text_1/repro.py and repro2.py, using /tmp/gsv39/bin/python with the dummy backend, the mfcc encoder and asr engine none. I deleted the temp workspaces afterwards because the disk was full.

Setup: I ran run_prepare, then set a suspect from proofcheck.build_suspect saying the other engine (funasr) heard 同事 for 同时. The standard library does not cover that change. Then I ran wf.run_transcript_fix(once=True), which is what the one-click correction calls.

- Before the one-click, the panel shows: "⚠️ 可能有错：另一个识别引擎听到的是「事」 识别 A（现在的文字）：…同时… 识别 B（建议改成）：…同事…"
- The one-click result is fixes=0, kept_auto=1, unsure=1, adopted.unsure=1. The stored suspect is {..., 'src': 'transcript', 'sure_alt': '区别在于我们需要同时给出键和值。'}, with no ref.
- After the one-click, the panel shows: "⚠️ 可能有错：另一个识别引擎听到的是「事」 现在的文字：…同时… 按母本改成：…同事…"

So the program refuses to auto-apply this guess, which is exactly why the row is still red, yet the panel credits it to the mother library.

Second case (repro2): a row flagged red with no suggestion becomes "按母本改成：（没有建议。请听一听录音…）", which is also wrong.

Why it happens:
- transcript_fix.py:1322-1333: when fixes is empty and auto edits remain, merge_with_auto rebuilds the suspect with "src": "transcript". allow_unchanged defaults to False, and run_transcript_fix at line 1766 does not pass it.
- app.py:2838 sets from_tr from src alone.
- That goes through app.py:2845 into _render_diff, then app.py:1311 calls render_diff_html with label_b="按母本改成". The no-suggestion line (tag_none) uses label_b too.

The same label also appears on mixed rows, where some changes come from the library and some from the other engine.

Why the teacher reaches it: 🔍 自动查找, or the automatic check during prepare, produces these flags; she then runs 📝 一键全部文字校正 as the help tells her (TEXTFIX_HELP: 「以你的母本标准库为准」); then she clicks a row that is still red, which is the step the program asks her to take.

Not intended design: render_diff_html's docstring says label_b is for suggestions that do not come from a recognition engine. Not reported before: nothing in research/全面找bug/README.md or the hunt reports.

Why medium and not high: the reason line just above the label still says 「另一个识别引擎听到的是…」, and nothing is changed until she clicks 采用. But the label is the big line, it contradicts the reason, and it breaks the rule that everything shown to the teacher must be true. It points her toward adopting wrong words into the training text on every row that is still red after the one-click.
verdict.fix:
Record where each suggestion came from inside merge_with_auto, and choose the label from that record.

1. voicetwin/data/transcript_fix.py, near lines 1331-1333: add one field to sus, e.g. `sus["by"] = "auto" if not fixes else ("mixed" if edits_keep or red_keep else "mother")`.

2. voicetwin/webui/app.py, around lines 2838-2845: keep using `from_tr` for the 母本里的原句 row. Choose the second-line label separately:
   - by == "mother", or the field is missing (older manifests): keep 「按母本改成」.
   - by == "auto": no label_b, so the panel goes back to 识别 A / 识别 B, as before the one-click.
   - by == "mixed": a neutral label such as 「建议改成（母本 + 另一个识别引擎）」.
   - alt is empty: never use 「按母本改成」.

   To do this, _render_diff (app.py:1303) needs to take a label string instead of the transcript bool.

What it could break:
- Rows checked before this change have no "by" field, so they keep the wrong label until the one-click runs again. This is acceptable.
- The new field does not affect the fp check, _same_result, _rebase, _drop_rejected or known_states. They compare alt, sure_alt, red and fp, not dict equality. One thing to check: the "same" short-circuit at line 1757 keeps the old suspect, which has no "by" field until the fingerprint changes.
- Tests that assert the exact panel HTML for transcript rows would need updating.

Do not change src itself: src == "transcript" is what makes review.py:384 treat sure_alt as vetted, and what makes the one-click skip the unsure guesses.
verdict.notes: Both repros confirm the claim exactly. A related issue the finder did not mention: on a red row with no suggestion, the "no suggestion" line also gets the 按母本改成 label. The fix above covers both.

h1.title: A browser tab left open from the old version keeps working against the new server and fires unrelated v18.5 handlers (v18.2 page: clicking the 「② 训练模型」 tab starts 🔍 自动查找; v18.4 page: 「⬆ 上一处」 saves all drafts and confirms training material)
h1.scenario: The teacher follows the upgrade steps: she closes the v18.2 black window but leaves the browser tab open (快速上手.md:11 only says 「先关掉它的黑色窗口」). She extracts over the folder, re-runs install_windows.bat, and the launcher starts v18.5 on the same port 127.0.0.1:7860 and opens a second tab. Later she clicks in the old v18.2 tab, for example the 「② 训练模型」 tab.
h1.actual: The old page still sends events using its v18.2 event numbers (fn_index), and the new server runs whatever v18.5 handler has that number. Verified in a real browser (gradio 4.24, chromium). In a v18.2 page, selecting the tab 「② 训练模型」 (v18.2 fn 43 = train_plan_preview) ran v18.5 fn 43 = do_proofcheck. The new server logged 「查错字完成：检查了 20 条…」 and the old page's training tab showed 「✅ 全部完成 … 「查找可能的错字」已经做好了」. On the teacher's machine this means the second recognition engine re-reads all ~1000 clips (minutes of GPU), rewrites the 可能有错 marks, and blocks other tasks with 「后台正在…」. In a v18.4 page, 「⬆ 上一处」 (fn 33) ran v18.5 do_confirm: it saved every unsaved edit and wrote review_confirmed.json, and the toast said 「✅ 训练素材已确认：20 条」, without the teacher ever pressing confirm. The dependency tables show more collisions: v18.4 batch-size input (fn 59) → do_select (starts 重新挑选最佳模型), v18.4 🔍 查找 (fn 31) → do_save, v18.2 保存修改 (fn 29) → do_clip_action, v18.2 row-menu action (fn 28) → clip_pick. The last two are why edits made in the stale tab are not stored. A v18.2 epochs-field input mapped to do_textfix but was stopped by gradio's File validation, so the one-use one-click was not consumed.
h1.expected: A page built by another version (or by an earlier launch) must not be able to run handlers on the new server. It should show 「声音分身已经更新 / 重新打开了，请按 F5 刷新网页」 and do nothing else.
h1.evidence: gradio 4.24 (/tmp/gsv39 site-packages) blocks.py:1351 `if len(inputs) < len(dep_inputs):` (only too few inputs is rejected) and queueing.py:206-212 queues `body.fn_index` with no check. voicetwin/webui/app.py:4088-4089: the hidden version `gr.HTML(f'<span data-vt-version=...>', elem_id="vt-version")` is used only by launcher.py:311-326, which checks old *servers*, not old *pages*. No reload/staleness guard exists (grep shows no location.reload or app_id check). Dependency dumps: r3/deps_v182.json, deps_v184.json, deps_v185.json. Browser runs: r4/out_tab_train_v182.txt shows 「15:58:26 | 查错字完成：检查了 20 条…」. r4/out_prev_v184.txt shows 「review_confirmed.json before / after: False True」. Screenshots: r4/tab_train_2_after_click.png, r4/prev_2_after_click.png. Direct HTTP replay of the v18.2 epochs event: r4/post_old_event.py (do_textfix rejected with pydantic ValidationError for ListFiles).
h1.fix: (1) Client side, in the page head JS: remember gradio's per-launch `app_id` and the vt-version at load. On visibilitychange or focus, and before acting, fetch /config. If either differs, cover the page with a blocking Chinese notice asking her to press F5. (2) Server side, which also protects against the already-deployed v18.2/v18.4 pages: wrap /queue/join (FastAPI middleware on app.app) to reject a request whose trigger_id is not among blocks.dependencies[fn_index]['targets'], or whose fn_index is out of range. (3) Add 「也关掉以前打开的声音分身网页（浏览器标签页）」 to OLD_RUNNING_MSG, the installer's Wait-OldClosed text, 快速上手 and release_notes().

verdict.evidence:
I reproduced this on my own, with sources taken by `git archive` from 153ca72 (v18.2), d2483ac (v18.4) and HEAD (v18.5). Each run used gradio 4.24 in /tmp/gsv39, a dummy backend, the mfcc encoder, asr none, and headless chromium. Everything is under （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/upgrade_1/ (deps.py, serve.py, mkws.py, stale.py, deps_v18x.json, run_v182/, run_v184/, run_v184e/).

My own dependency dump gives the same fn_index tables as the finder's: v18.2 fn43 train_plan_preview (Tab ② select) becomes v18.5 do_proofcheck; v18.4 fn33 ⬆ 上一处 becomes do_confirm; v18.4 fn59 batch input becomes do_select; v18.4 fn28 do_clip_action becomes clip_pick; v18.4 fn31 查找 becomes do_save.

How each run worked: start the old server, load the page in chromium, SIGTERM the old server, start v18.5 on the same port, then click in the old page. The two servers had different app_id values each time.

(1) v18.2 page, clicking the 「② 训练模型」 tab: the page sent fn_index 43, trigger_id 67. The v18.5 log then shows 「准备识别引擎（第一次使用会先下载）……」 and 「查错字完成：检查了 20 条…」, and manifest.jsonl was rewritten.

(2) v18.4 page, clicking 「⬆ 上一处」: the page sent fn_index 33 with ['我的声音', False]. review_confirmed.json went from False to True. profile.json, references.json, transcripts.csv and the centroid were recomputed, and the log shows the confirm/profile lines.

(3) v18.4 page, a double-click text edit (the same hidden textbox and button the page script uses): the page sent fn_index 28, which landed in v18.5 clip_pick and failed with a TypeError (DataframeData from str). The edit was saved nowhere on disk.

The server side has no check at all. gradio 4.24 blocks.py validate_inputs rejects only too few inputs, and queueing.push queues body.fn_index as sent; trigger_id is never compared with dependencies[fn_index].targets.

The app has no guard either. app.py:4088 vt-version is read only by launcher.py, which detects old servers, not old pages, and there is no reload or app_id logic. research/全面找bug/README.md:102 fixes only the old black window that is still running. Nothing covers a stale tab, so this is not an already-fixed or accepted limitation.

How the teacher reaches it: 快速上手.md tells her to close only the black window. launcher.py picks 7860 first, so the new server takes the same port and opens a second tab. Both tabs are titled 「声音分身 VoiceTwin v18」 by design, so she cannot tell them apart.

What limits the impact: many of the remapped handlers fail on input-count or type validation. The one-use 一键校正 was not consumed in any mapping I checked (v18.4 fn46 to do_textfix has too few inputs). No permanent data loss was shown: the unwanted confirm is undone by the next edit, the proofcheck marks are regenerated, and a failed edit shows an error toast. So I rate it medium, not high.
verdict.fix:
There are three parts. Part (a) is the essential one because it also protects pages that are already deployed.

(a) Server side, voicetwin/webui/launcher.py (_build/launch, before launch): add a FastAPI middleware on app.app for POST /queue/join, and also /run/predict in case queueing is off. Pre-compute the trigger ids each dependency accepts: its own target ids, plus, for a .then/.success dependency (trigger_after set), the accepted ids of the upstream dependency. This is needed because gradio 4.24 passes the root trigger_id down the chain. Reject the request when fn_index is out of range, or when trigger_id is not null and not in the accepted set. A rejection should return an error the old page shows as a toast, e.g. 「声音分身已经更新或重新打开了，这个网页是旧的：请关掉它，或者按 F5 刷新」. Also reject when len(data) != len(inputs) for deps without js.

(b) Client side, page_js/GUARD_JS in app.py (next to the vt-version span at line 4088): remember window.gradio_config.app_id and data-vt-version at load. On focus or visibilitychange, fetch /config, and if either value differs, cover the page with a blocking Chinese notice asking for F5. This only protects pages built from now on.

(c) Docs: add 「也关掉以前打开的声音分身网页（浏览器标签页）」 to OLD_RUNNING_MSG, the installer's Wait-OldClosed text, the upgrade steps in 快速上手.md (then regenerate the PDF) and release_notes.

What the fix could break: load events and then-chains (their trigger_id is the root's or null; they must stay allowed); the JS-driven hidden buttons #vt-clip-action-btn and the find/replace buttons (fine, as long as their own ids are in targets); cancel/stop dependencies; any CLI or gradio_client call without trigger_id (allow null). The exact-length check must skip deps with js preprocessing. Both the middleware and the JS guard need tests: a fake stale page posting fn_index plus a foreign trigger_id gets refused, and the real page still passes the browser test.
verdict.notes:
The claim is accurate. On top of the finder's cases, I confirmed that an edit typed in a stale v18.4 tab is silently lost. The handler that receives it crashes (TypeError in clip_pick), so the teacher would at most see an error toast.

Not verified on the teacher's machine: how long the GPU proofcheck takes with the real second ASR engine; whether the 「第一次使用会先下载」 path could start a download there; and whether do_select reached through the v18.4 batch field would override a variant she chose by hand. I did not run that v18.4 batch-field case.

It only happens across versions: two launches of the same version build the same dependency order, so a stale tab from the same version runs the right handlers, though its gr.State values are lost.

I rated it medium instead of high because it needs the teacher to go back to the old tab, and every effect I reproduced can be undone.

h1.title: Tapping 保存修改 or ✅ 确认训练素材 while the edit box is open: the save runs before the edit, and the page says there is nothing to save
h1.scenario: The teacher double-clicks a 文字 cell and types a fix. Without pressing Enter, they tap 保存修改 (or ✅ 确认训练素材) with a laptop touchpad (tap-to-click sends mouse down and up about 0–10 ms apart).
h1.expected: REVIEW_JS is meant to send the edit first, when the button is pressed down, and then save or confirm. Its own comment says 「老师改完字紧接着点「保存修改 / 确认训练素材」时，改的字先送到」. The save should include the edit.
h1.actual: Gradio sends the save or confirm first and the edit arrives afterwards. Save: the message under the button is 「没有需要保存的修改（表格里没有 🔴 红灯的行）」 while the row stays 🔴 unsaved. Confirm: the page shows ✅ confirmed, and the table header switches straight to 「训练素材确认过…但后来又改了 1 条还没保存」, so 开始训练 is refused. Nothing is lost (the edit is kept as an unsaved change), but the message contradicts the table. With a normal mouse click (≥30 ms between press and release) the order is correct.
h1.evidence:
app.py:618-621 commits the editor on pointerdown: `document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (ev) => { if (editor && !editor.box.contains(ev.target)) closeEditor(...)`. send() at app.py:439-443 then sets the hidden textbox and calls `setTimeout(() => btn.click(), 0);`, so the hidden 'clip-action' click happens one task later. The browser handles a native mouseup/click before that 0 ms timer when down and up arrive together. Both events share concurrency_id 'vt-review' (app.py:4438-4448) and are processed in arrival order, so the save runs first. app.py:3063: `return "没有需要保存的修改（表格里没有 🔴 红灯的行）。"`.
Repro e04_tap_save.py (press-to-release delay → saved?): 0 ms → False, False; 10 ms → False, True; 30 ms → True, True; 120 ms → True, True.
Repro e05_tap_race.py output: 「== 轻点「保存修改」：这一行保存了吗 = False；还在没保存的修改里 = True … 🔴 还有 1 条修改没有保存」 and 「== 轻点「✅ 确认训练素材」：这一行保存了吗 = False … ⚠️ 训练素材确认过（10-03 16:12），但后来又改了 1 条还没保存」. Screenshot shots/e03_5.png shows 「没有需要保存的修改」 under the button while the row has 🔴.
h1.fix: Send the pending edit synchronously in the pointerdown handler: set the textbox value and call btn.click() directly instead of setTimeout(0). Alternatively, give 保存修改 / 确认训练素材 a js= pre-step that flushes an open editor first, or have do_save/do_confirm briefly wait for an in-flight clip action.

verdict.evidence:
I reproduced this in a real browser (Chromium plus Playwright) against my own server running the current code (gradio 4.24, /tmp/gsv39). Setup: dummy backend, mfcc encoder, asr engine none, 30 rows. Scripts are in （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/browser_1/ (setup.py, tap.py, order.py, fixcheck.py).

Each test double-clicks a 文字 cell, types a character without pressing Enter, then does mouse.down() and mouse.up() on the button with a set gap between them.

Results with the current code:
- 保存修改 at 0 ms: saved=False, the row is still in review_draft.json, and the message under the buttons is 「没有需要保存的修改（表格里没有 🔴 红灯的行）」 while the row shows 🔴 (shot_保存修改_0.png).
- 保存修改 at 10 ms: saved=False, same message.
- 保存修改 at 30 ms and 120 ms: saved=True.
- In fixcheck.py two rows had been edited with Enter beforehand. A 0 ms tap then reported 「✅ 已保存 2 条」: the older edits were saved and the one just typed was left 🔴.
- ✅ 确认训练素材 at 0 ms: the page shows 「✅ 训练素材已确认：30 − 2 … = 28 条」 and the toast 「✅ 训练素材已确认：28 条」, while the row is still a draft and the table header says 「⚠️ 训练素材确认过（…），但后来又改了 1 条还没保存」 (shot_确认_0.png). At 120 ms the confirm includes the edit.

Why it happens: order.py logs the events in the browser. At 0 ms the order is pointerdown 5233.7, pointerup 5235.9, click on 保存修改 5235.9, and only then click on vt-clip-action-btn 5254.5. The setTimeout(0) at app.py:443 fires about 20 ms after pointerdown, because closeEditor's DOM work and the Svelte input update keep the main thread busy. So the native click on 保存修改 and its /queue/join (fn 31) go out before the edit (fn 29). Both share concurrency_id 'vt-review' (app.py:4438-4448), so the server handles them in arrival order and do_save finds no draft.

Who can hit it: tap-to-click on a laptop touchpad sends press and release only a few ms apart, and a slower Windows laptop makes that 20 ms window wider. This is exactly the case the code comment at app.py:440-442 and the earlier fix e9fc091 meant to cover, so it is not intended behaviour. research/全面找bug/README.md does not list it.

Why low and not medium: nothing is lost. The edit stays as a 🔴 draft, the row message says 「✏️ 第 N 条改好了（🔴 没保存）」, a second 保存修改 saves it (checked), and the training gate refuses to start and says to save and confirm again. The real harm is two confusing, false messages for the teacher: "nothing to save" and "✅ 已确认".
verdict.fix:
In voicetwin/webui/app.py:443 (inside send() in REVIEW_JS_TEMPLATE), replace `setTimeout(() => btn.click(), 0);` with `Promise.resolve().then(() => btn.click());` and update the comment at lines 440-442.

Why it works: the input event dispatched just before it queues Svelte's flush as a microtask. The new microtask runs right after that flush, so the hidden textbox value is already in gradio's state. It also runs before the browser handles the next input event (mouseup or click), so the edit's /queue/join always goes out before the save or confirm.

Tested in the browser with patched copies of the package: the microtask version and a plain synchronous `btn.click()` (the finder's suggestion) both gave saved=True at 0, 0 and 10 ms, and edits committed with Enter still arrived. I still recommend the microtask over the synchronous click, because the synchronous click only works if gradio has already picked up the textbox value when the click fires. If it ever reads a stale value, do_clip_action would replay the previous payload, which has no seq dedupe (for example toggling 'lang' again or repeating a delete). The microtask removes that risk.

What else it could touch: the hidden click now fires inside the pointerdown or click handler's microtask checkpoint instead of in a later task. REVIEW_JS's own document click listeners also see that synthetic click. They ignore it: it is not inside #vt-clips td or #vt-find-all, and closeMenu() is harmless. A Playwright regression test should be added that does mouse.down/up 0 ms apart on 保存修改 and on 确认训练素材 while the editor is open. If the project wants extra safety, do_save could also handle a draft that arrives right after it ran, but that is not needed.
verdict.notes: I kept my servers on ports 7961-7963 under pid files and stopped them with kill <pid>; I never used pkill -f or pgrep -f. The repo was not modified; the patched copies are in scratchpad patched_sync/ and patched_micro/. One thing I left unexplained: in order.py's 30 ms run, the tap's save request did not show up in the Playwright request log within 5 s, yet tap.py's 30 ms run did save (「✅ 已保存 1 条」). It is probably a logging artifact and does not change the conclusion. A touchscreen tap (about 50-150 ms between press and release) and a normal mouse click (30 ms or more here) do not trigger the race.

h1.title: After a reload or closing the browser during a long 生成, the finished audio cannot be reached from the page (no player, no download, no 「📂 打开保存文件夹」)
h1.scenario: The teacher starts a long 完美 generation. The page says 可以去做别的事, so they close the browser tab (or press F5) and come back after it finishes.
h1.expected: The page shows the last result, or at least a way to open it: the 结果 player, the download list, or the 打开保存文件夹 button.
h1.actual: Only the top banner says 「✅ 上次的「生成讲课音频」（声音：我的声音）已经在 16:59 完成。」. The ③ tab has no player, no download links, and no 打开保存文件夹 / 在文件夹里找到这个文件 button, because that row is hidden until a generation finishes in the current page session. Clicking 生成 again with the empty box only says 「请先在「讲稿」框里粘贴讲稿」. The quick-start path `D:\VoiceTwin\workspace\我的声音\outputs` is not where this teacher installed (D:\VoiceTwin-Windows-v18.2\VoiceTwin).
h1.evidence:
app.py:4283 `with gr.Row(visible=False) as gen_after:` holds open_dir/locate/ev_jump. It is made visible only in do_generate's success yield (app.py:3685 `gen_after=_upd(visible=True)`). on_load (app.py:2665-2676) restores nothing from the last report, although _latest_report() exists (app.py:2178).

h1.evidence: app.py:2627-2631 `if v: _review.clear_find(wf.Project(self.cfg, v))` in on_voice_change. app.py:2672 on_load calls on_voice_change. app.py:4397 voice.change also calls it. Repro output: `tab1 next   : 🔍 找到 9 处「推导式」… 现在是第 2 处` → `tab2 opened -> find state on disk: {}` → `tab1 next   : 请先输入要找的字，点「🔍 查找」。` → `tab1 replace: … 现在是第 1 处 … 先找到了第一处（橙色）。`
h1.fix: Clear the find state only on an explicit 「✖ 关闭查找」 or when the voice really changes within the same tab: keep it per browser session in a gr.State, or pass the previous voice and skip clear_find on page load. I reproduced it with （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/conflicts_3/v3.py. It uses /tmp/gsv39/bin/python with a fresh temp workspace (dummy backend, mfcc, ASR none, nothing downloaded). One WebUI object serves every tab, the same as in the real app.

- `T1 next   : … 现在是第 2 处（第 3 条）`
- `T1 replace: 🔍 找到 14 处 … 现在是第 2 处（第 7 条）✅ 第 3 条换好了`

- The comment at 2627 only wants the tab being opened to start with no search active. Wiping another tab's search is a side effect.
- Neither research/全面找bug/README.md nor 教学手册 mentions or accepts it.

Why only low severity:
- No text is lost. The replacements stay in the draft (red light), review_undo.json is untouched, and clicking 🔍 查找 again recovers.
- She has to go back to the older tab in the middle of a search.
- The impact is a confusing message, a lost position (matches she skipped on purpose come back) and the "already replaced" rows dropping out of the list.

Smallest safe fix: let 上一处/下一处 rebuild the search from the find box, the same way do_replace_one already does.
1. app.py:2930: change the signature to `do_find_move(self, voice, delta, only_sus=False, query=None, word=True)`. After `find = _review.load_find(project)`, add: `q = str(query or '').strip()`. Show 「请先输入要找的字」 only when the box really is empty.
2. app.py:4457/4459: wire the inputs as `[c['voice'], c['only_sus'], c['find_q'], c['find_word']]` and change the lambdas to `lambda v, o, q, w: self.do_find_move(v, ±1, o, q, w)`.
The message is then correct, but the old position and the ids list are still lost.

Fuller fix: stop sharing the state between tabs. Either keep the find state in a per-session gr.State, or have on_load render the table without the find filter instead of deleting review_find.json, and clear the file only on 「✖ 关闭查找」, a real voice switch, or an empty-query 查找. - _safe("查找", 4, 0) is unchanged (still 4 outputs).

Refreshing (F5) the same tab also clears the box, so a single tab stays consistent. Within one tab, switching the voice clears the new voice's find state, which is also consistent. h1.title: F5 during 一键全部文字校正: the result summary is never shown and the table goes stale, so the next 保存修改 accepts ~117 changes the teacher never saw
h1.scenario: The teacher clicks 📝 一键全部文字校正 and reloads the page while it runs. The table now shows the old text with no red rows. They fix one sentence themselves and click 保存修改. Later they click the 一键 button again, hoping to see the result.

h1.actual: The background run finishes, but the reloaded page is never refreshed, so the program's drafts are invisible. The teacher's 保存修改 reports 「✅ 已保存 118 条：改了 118 条的文字」 (1 their own, 117 from the program, unreviewed). The second click started a new run that only reports 「检查了新加的 1 条…没有需要改的地方」. The first run's summary, including the 没有把握 rows, is never shown, and the button is now grey.
h1.evidence:
do_textfix (app.py:3398-3419) refreshes the table only when the click that started the run, or a click that attaches while it is still running, is still connected. on_load does not refresh when the task ends (only the banner text changes). _attaching() is False once the task has finished, so a later click starts a new run instead of showing the last result (app.py:3368-3372).
Repro e11_textfix_reload.py output: 「after reload: btn enabled: True」, 「save during textfix: ['✅ 已保存 118 条：改了 118 条的文字…']」, 「RESULT: 一键全部文字校正完成：检查了新加的 1 条（以前改过的句子一点没动），没有需要改的地方」.
h1.fix: Keep the last textfix summary in a file and show it on load or when the button is clicked after the run ends (like ATTACH_MISSED_MD, but with the content). Refresh the table when a background task finishes, for example from the banner or from after_task polling.

verdict.evidence:
I reproduced it without a browser by calling the same WebUI methods the page calls. Script: （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/browser_5/repro.py. Workspace: 1008 teacher rows from the finder's setup.py, dummy backend, mfcc speaker encoder, asr engine none.

Steps: start do_textfix, take the first yield, then gen.close() to act as F5. Then on_load, then wait for the background task to end.

Scenario A (the finder's, with one edit while the run is going):
- After reload the table has 0 red rows out of 1008. The banner is frozen at 「🔄 后台正在…完成 1%」.
- The edit goes through because "edit" is not guarded during textfix. The table it sends back shows 1 red row.
- The task ends with 125 drafts on disk.
- do_save then returns 「✅ 已保存 125 条：改了 125 条的文字（这几行现在是 🟢）」. The teacher meant to save 1 row and the other 124 came from the program.
- The one-click summary (_textfix_md: counts, examples, 没有把握, 下一步) is never shown anywhere.
- The finder's extra point, that a second click starts a new 1-row run, only happens when the edit lands in the middle of processing (skipped_edited). That is designed behaviour. In my run the edit landed before the rows were read, so new_ids was 0 and the button went grey.

Scenario B (plain F5, no edit):
- After the run ends, the reloaded page still has the button enabled.
- Clicking it, as the banner says, gives TEXTFIX_ONCE_MSG (「…改好的地方都在下面的表格里，还没保存的请点「保存修改」…」).
- The chained .then(refresh_clips) then shows the 124 red rows. So the designed recovery path does refresh the table, but the summary is gone for good.

Why the summary is lost: it only exists inside the generator of the click that started the run, or of a click that attaches while it is still running (app.py:3398-3419). on_load builds the table and banner once and has no timer. _attaching() is False once the task has finished, and the button is once per batch, so the summary cannot be produced again. The finished value only stays in memory, in tasks._CURRENT.state["value"] (tasks.py:242).

Parts of the claim that are overstated:
- The table is stale only until the next server round trip: any table action, the button click, 🔄 刷新表格, or a second F5.
- The save message shows the real count (125).
- The program's changes are the ones the teacher asked for. Looking them over first is advice, not a gate: the same unreviewed save can happen without any F5.
- The saved rows stay visible as 🟢, and rows with an adopted suggestion keep their undo button (review.unadopt_suggestion works on the current text).

This is not in research/全面找bug/README.md, and it is not an accepted limitation. It is a real but small loss of information after a reload. The general "refresh and reattach" design never delivers the result of a task that finished while no page was attached.
verdict.fix:
The minimal fix is to show the finished run's summary to the next page that asks for it:

1. voicetwin/webui/tasks.py: add a helper, e.g. last_result(kind, voice). It returns _CURRENT.state.get("value") when the current task has finished, matches kind and voice, and has not been delivered yet. Set a delivered flag when stream_task hands the done state to a connected generator.

2. voicetwin/webui/app.py do_textfix, around line 3368: in the branch `not attach and self._textfix_used(v)`, call last_result("textfix", v). If it returns a value, yield proof_md=_textfix_md(value) with a short lead such as 「刚才刷新网页时，一键全部文字校正已经在后台做完了，结果如下」, plus tr_info and tr_btn. Keep the existing .then(refresh_clips) chain, which already updates the table. Optionally also put the summary into proof_md from on_load when the banner says the textfix finished (that needs proof_md added to on_load's outputs).

Optional for the stale-table part: in do_save, when the draft count on disk is larger than the number of red rows the page sent (the clips table is already an input), add a line to the message such as 「其中 N 条是一键校正改的」.

What this could break:
- The summary can show up twice (once in another tab, once here) unless the delivered flag is shared.
- Its 「下一步：这些行现在是 🔴 没保存」 line is wrong if the teacher has already saved; reword it, or leave it out when the drafts are gone.
- The value is memory-only, so it is lost when the program restarts. That is acceptable, but do not claim more than that in the message.
- The exact-silence, title and once-per-batch rules are not affected.
verdict.notes: The repro prints were checked on two runs of each scenario. The textfix run takes about 8 s here for 1008 rows, so the F5 window is short but real. On the teacher's PC it will be longer, because the run also re-runs the post-save re-stat and voiceprint step. The frozen 「后台正在…1%」 banner after F5 is a general issue (there is no polling, and gradio 4.24 has no gr.Timer). It is not specific to textfix.

app.py:2642 `value = _voice_name(current) or (names[0] if names else DEFAULT_VOICE)`. Names come from workflows.py:220 `for d in sorted(p for p in ws.iterdir() if p.is_dir())` (alphabetical), while the library is sorted most recent first at workflows.py:357 `rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-(r["modified"] or 0.0), r["voice"]))`.

verdict.evidence:
Reproduced with （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/browser_6/repro.py (temp workspace, dummy backend, mfcc, asr none). I made 我的声音 (manifest mtime 1 day old) and 第二个声音 (mtime now), then called WebUI.on_load(), which is what page open and F5 run:
  names (dropdown order): ['我的声音', '第二个声音']
  library order: ['第二个声音', '我的声音']
  on_load selected voice: 我的声音
  build() initial value: 我的声音
After adding an untrained 字幕测试 (1 hour old): names = ['字幕测试', '我的声音', '第二个声音'] and on_load picks 字幕测试.

Code path:
- app.py:4389 app.load(... self.on_load ...)
- app.py:2670 on_load calls refresh_voices(running_voice or None). It only keeps the right voice while a background task for it is still running.
- app.py:2642 `value = _voice_name(current) or (names[0] if names else DEFAULT_VOICE)`
- names come from workflows._voice_dirs (workflows.py:220, `sorted(...)` by directory name, so Unicode order: 字 U+5B57 < 我 U+6211 < 第 U+7B2C).
- The 我的声音库 table on the same page is sorted newest first (workflows.py:357), so the dropdown and the first library row disagree.
- build() at app.py:4099 also uses names[0] as the initial value.
- Nothing remembers the last voice: grep found no last_voice, localStorage or BrowserState.

Not intended design and not already fixed: research/全面找bug/README.md does not list it, and no doc says the default should be the alphabetical first.

Mitigations, which keep it at low:
- It only matters with 2 or more voices where the active one is not alphabetically first, for example a retry voice 我的声音2 or a test voice.
- The voice name is in a dropdown at the top of the page, above all tabs.
- 快速上手 step 8 tells the teacher to pick 我的声音 in 声音名称 before generating.
- With GPT-SoVITS, generating on an untrained voice shows the ⚠️「这个声音还没有训练…通用模型」warning (_gen_warn_md, app.py:1178). It is not data loss.
- The real risk is wasted generation time, or prepare adding new videos to the wrong voice, if the teacher does not notice the switch.
verdict.fix:
In app.py:2640-2643 refresh_voices, when no current voice is passed, default to the most recently modified voice (the same order as 我的声音库) instead of names[0]:
```python
names = _voices(self.cfg)
value = _voice_name(current)
if not value and names:
    try:
        value = next((e["name"] for e in _library_entries(self.cfg) if e["name"] in names), names[0])
    except Exception:
        value = names[0]
return _upd(choices=names, value=value or DEFAULT_VOICE)
```
Optionally make build() at app.py:4099 use the same helper. on_load overrides that value right away anyway.

What it could break or change:
- on_load reads every voice's file mtimes one more time (_library_entries is already called once by library()). That is slightly slower with many voices; passing the entries in would avoid it.
- "Most recently modified" is not "last viewed". If the teacher only looked at a voice without changing anything, F5 still goes to the voice that was last changed.
- The refresh button passes the current value, so it is unaffected.
- tests/test_webui_helpers.py::test_on_load_outputs uses a single voice, so it still passes. A new test with two voices and different mtimes should be added.

Alternative: remember the last selected voice in the workspace (a small file written in on_voice_change). This is more exact but adds a write on every switch and needs care with two tabs.
verdict.notes: The finder's e09 scenario (prepare, then F5) only hit names[0] because the dummy prepare had already finished before the reload. For the teacher a real prepare takes minutes, and F5 during it correctly selects the running voice. The bug shows after the task ends: the next day, or after any later reload. The finder's 字幕测试 generate case is the more convincing one: with the default backend the warning appears, but generation still runs on the generic model.

h1.title: After 「保存修改」 the result says the teacher's own deletions were 「自动去掉了 … 老师删除」 under a 「素材准备好了」 heading
h1.scenario: Teacher deletes two rows (purple), edits one row and clicks 保存修改, or 💾 保存这一行. The same block also appears after a later 开始准备素材.
h1.actual: The save result reads 「✅ 已保存 1 条…」 followed by 「### ✅ 素材准备好了：可用 2.2 分钟…」 and 「自动去掉了 2 条（共 1 种原因）：1. 老师删除：2 条」, plus the whole reminder and reference list again. Her own deletions are called automatic, and she is referred to in the third person (「老师删除」) while the rest of the UI says 「你删除的」.
h1.expected: No 「素材准备好了」 heading after a save. Manual deletions should read 「你删除的：2 条」 and not be counted under 「自动去掉了」.
h1.evidence:
app.py:3074-3075 `if res.get("summary"): md += "

" + _summary_md(res["summary"])`; app.py:1633 「### ✅ 素材准备好了：可用…」; app.py:1639 「自动去掉了 {total} 条（共 {len(dropped)} 种原因）」; prepare.py:433 `r["drop_reason"] = "老师删除"`; prepare.py:634 default 「手动删除」. Repro output shows exactly 「自动去掉了 2 条（共 1 种原因）：

1. 老师删除：2 条」 under 「### ✅ 素材准备好了」 after do_save.
h1.fix: Use a short summary for saves (no heading, or only changed counts). In prepare.apply_filters use 「你删除的」. In _summary_md, list deleted rows separately from automatic drops.

verdict.evidence:
I reproduced this with （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/text_4/verify_save_msg.py. Output is saved next to it as verify_save_msg.out.txt. Setup: dummy backend, mfcc encoder, asr none. The workspace was on /dev/shm because / was full (ENOSPC) and was deleted afterwards. The steps were the normal web UI handlers: WebUI.do_clip_action delete twice, edit once, then WebUI.do_save.

Save result shown to the teacher:
"✅ 已保存 1 条：改了 1 条的文字（这几行现在是 🟢）
### ✅ 素材准备好了：可用 **2.2 分钟**（英文 0.6 分钟，中文 1.5 分钟），一共 28 条
自动去掉了 2 条（共 1 种原因）：
1. 老师删除：2 条
> ⚠️ 提醒（共 2 条）…
**自动挑选的参考录音**…"

「💾 保存这一行」(action save_row) gives the same block. In my run it read 「自动去掉了 3 条（共 2 种原因）：1. 老师删除：2 条 2. 语速异常…」. A later wf.run_prepare also prints 「自动去掉了 3 条 … 1. 老师删除：2 条」 under 「### ✅ 素材准备好了」.

Code path:
- workflows.review_save (workflows.py:584-594) sets res["summary"] = apply_review(...), which calls prepare.summarize.
- summarize (prepare.py:626-636) counts every keep=False row under its drop_reason, with "手动删除" as the default.
- apply_filters (prepare.py:431-433) sets drop_reason="老师删除" on rows the teacher deleted. review.py:1103 uses DELETED_REASON = "老师删除".
- app.WebUI._save_md (app.py:3074-3075) appends _summary_md(res["summary"]).
- _summary_md (app.py:1633, 1639) prints the 「### ✅ 素材准备好了」 heading and 「自动去掉了 {total} 条」, which lumps the teacher's own deletions in with the automatic filter drops.

The delete action itself (app.py:3151-3155) gives a short message using 「你」-style wording, and the confirm path calls these rows 「紫色 = 你删除的」 (app.py:3046). So the save summary contradicts the rest of the UI. It calls the teacher's own deletions automatic, which breaks CLAUDE.md rule 7 (不要乱写), and it refers to her in the third person. Rows dropped by editing keep=0 in Excel also land here, as "手动删除" (project.py:215).

This is not intended design, not an accepted limitation, and not in research/全面找bug/README.md. The existing tests only check the start of the save message (test_webui_helpers.py:168) and the prepare heading (test_webui_build.py:103). It is low severity because no data is wrong: the minute count and clip count are correct, and only the wording is misleading.
verdict.fix:
Change only the display in voicetwin/webui/app.py. Do NOT change the stored string "老师删除" in prepare.py:433 or review.py:31. That value is written into the drop_reason column of transcripts.csv. transcript_fix.py:157 reads it back to leave deleted rows out of the txt/逐字稿 flow, and tests/test_transcript_fix.py and the old research scripts depend on it. Renaming it would break old projects and older CSVs.

1) In _summary_md (app.py:1636-1639), split `dropped` before building the text. Pull out manual = dropped.pop("老师删除", 0) + dropped.pop("手动删除", 0). Print 「自动去掉了 N 条…」 only for what is left, and add a separate line 「你删除的：{manual} 条（紫色，不用来训练）」 when manual > 0. Work on a copy so the dict in prepare_summary.json is not changed.

2) In _save_md (app.py:3074-3075), skip the 「### ✅ 素材准备好了」 heading after a save. One way is a `heading` parameter on _summary_md (default kept for the prepare path, so test_webui_build.py:103 still passes). The other is to append only a short line such as 「现在可用 X 分钟，一共 N 条」 plus warnings. Dropping the repeated reference list after a save is optional.

What could break:
- Any test or browser script that expects 「老师删除」 or 「素材准备好了」 in a save message. I found none: test_webui_helpers.py:306 only checks the 太短/识别置信度低 wording, and the prepare-heading checks are unchanged.
- The 「共 X 种原因」 count changes when manual deletions are left out.
- If the warnings are dropped from the save output, the 「可用素材只有…分钟」 reminder would no longer show after a save. Keep the warnings.
verdict.notes: The save path, the save-row path and the later re-prepare path all show 「自动去掉了 … 老师删除」. That part of the claim is accurate. Whether a summary should appear after a save at all is partly a style question: the code comment says saving re-runs the statistics 「和以前的保存一样」. Even so, a 「素材准备好了」 heading after editing one word is odd, and calling her own deletions 「自动去掉」 is plainly wrong. The root filesystem was full during verification, so the run used /dev/shm, and it was cleaned up afterwards.

h1.title: 「只重新生成第几句（…；留空 = 全部）」: leaving it empty regenerates nothing, and there is no way to regenerate everything
h1.scenario: Teacher dislikes the whole result. Following the field label (blank = all), she leaves it empty and clicks 生成 again for a fresh take.
h1.actual: Every sentence comes from the cache: hints show 「沿用上次」 on every row, the notes say 「全部用的是之前生成好的结果」, and the audio is sample-identical except for 1-LSB rounding on 2130 samples (max diff 3.05e-05). Nothing was regenerated, and the only feedback is in small print. Regenerating every sentence means typing the full range by hand (for example 1-50).
h1.expected: Label something like 「留空 = 整篇（已经生成好的句子直接沿用，不重新生成）」, and ideally offer a 「全部重新生成」 option or mention the 1-N range.
h1.evidence: app.py:4262 `label="只重新生成第几句（例如 3,5,8-10；留空 = 全部）"`; engine.py:670-672 `if plan.cached and not force: return self._load_cached(seg, plan)`; force only for redo numbers (engine.py:874). Repro: 「每句是否沿用上次： [True, True, True]」, 「结果表的提示列： ['沿用上次', '沿用上次', '沿用上次']」, 「最大差： 3.0517578125e-05」.
h1.fix: Reword the label (and the 快速上手 line about redo). Optionally add a checkbox 「全部重新生成（不用上次的结果）」 that passes redo=all.

verdict.evidence:
Reproduced with （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/text_7/verify_redo_blank.py (dummy backend, mfcc, asr none, temp workspace, no network). The web UI does exactly this: do_generate (app.py:3635) calls `_parse_redo("")`, which returns [], and passes redo=[] to wf.run_narrate. engine.synthesize_all only forces the numbers in redo_set (engine.py:874), and synthesize_segment returns the cached result whenever `plan.cached and not force` (engine.py:670-672). Results from my run:
- Second run with the field left empty: cached flags [True, True, True]; hint column ['沿用上次']*3; the only other note is the small-print 「本次生成：共 3 句，全部用的是之前生成好的结果。」; no 「已重新生成」 line. Max diff against the first run is 3.05e-05 (1-LSB rounding), so it is the same audio.
- Extra finding: generation without force is fully deterministic. seed0 = base_seed + index*7919, and the seed only gets randomized when force=True (engine.py:677-679). When I deleted the cache and generated again with the field empty, I got the same seeds [20345330, 20353249, 20256439] and max diff 0.0. So "blank = all" can never give a fresh take, whether or not a cache exists. The only way to redo everything is to type every number (e.g. 1-3); that run used random seeds [20884442, ...] and produced different audio (even a different length).
- Nothing tells her about the 1-N workaround: the label (app.py:4262), 快速上手.md:129 and the CLI --redo help all describe only partial redo.
How she hits it: she dislikes the whole result, leaves the field empty because the label says 「留空 = 全部」, and clicks 生成 again. Nothing is lost and the UI does say 沿用上次 on every row, but the label's literal meaning (blank = regenerate all) is wrong. This is not intended design and not in research/全面找bug/README.md. Severity is low: it is a misleading label with feedback in small print and an easy but undocumented workaround.
verdict.fix:
Main fix is text only, at voicetwin/webui/app.py:4262. Change the label to something like 「只重新生成第几句（例如 3,5,8-10；留空 = 已经生成过的句子直接用上次的结果；想整篇重来就填 1-最后一句的编号）」. Add the same 1-N tip to 快速上手.md:129, then rebuild docs/快速上手.pdf as the handbook's 16.11 says, and add it to the CLI --redo help at cli.py:161. No test checks the label text (grep of tests found none). Changing it does affect the 快速上手 screenshots and PDF.

Optional behaviour fix: add a 「全部重新生成（不用上次的结果）」 checkbox, or accept the word 全部 in _parse_redo. _parse_redo does not know the sentence count, so it would have to return a sentinel, or the UI would pass range(1, REDO_MAX+1). Out-of-range numbers are then a problem: synthesize_all puts every number above n into `bad` and adds a 「第 … 句不存在，已跳过」 warning. With range(1, REDO_MAX+1) that warning would list about 100000 numbers, so redo-all must be capped at n or handled separately. Redo-all also forces random seeds and fresh synthesis for every sentence. On a long lecture with a real GPU backend that takes minutes, and the cached 去杂音 variants get deleted (engine.py:815). Both are what she asked for, but the UI should say so.
verdict.notes: Refutation attempts that failed. (1) "留空 = 全部" could be read as "blank = generate the whole lecture". It does, but the field heading is 只重新生成第几句, so the natural reading is "blank = regenerate all", and that is false. (2) Clearing the cache would not give her a fresh take either: seeds are deterministic without force, so the result is the same to the bit. That makes the label more misleading, not less. (3) The UI does show the truth (沿用上次 on every row, small-print note), and generation finishes almost instantly, so she would probably notice. That keeps severity at low, but the label is still wrong. Repro script: （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/text_7/verify_redo_blank.py

h1.title: Unmeasured durations: the blind test says 「大约几分钟」 while silently using the ③ tab's 完美 tier; selection 「大约 5~15 分钟」 and 找错字 「5 分钟」 were never measured
h1.scenario: Teacher opens ⑤ 鉴别 and clicks 生成盲听测试 (default 10 sentences). Her ③ 质量 is auto-set to 完美 on her 8 GB card. She also reads the training progress line after training, and 快速上手 step 6½.
h1.actual: The blind-test intro promises 「（会用到显卡，大约几分钟）」, but build() passes the ③ tab's 质量 radio. With 完美 each sentence runs the adaptive loop (up to 20 tries, forced ASR check), and the ⑤ tab does not say which quality it uses. 「训练完成，开始自动挑选最像你的模型（大约 5~15 分钟）」 has never been measured: real selection hung before v18.4 and the teacher has not reported since (时间线: 「等老师升级后反馈挑选 / 生成的结果」). 快速上手 「找错字（推荐，5 分钟）」 has no measurement either, and a 🔍 pass over ~1000 clips runs a second ASR engine on every clip. This goes against the rule that shown numbers must be measured.
h1.expected: Either measured figures, or honest wording (「时间取决于句子数和质量档，完美档会比较久」), and the blind test should state (or let her pick) the quality it uses.
h1.evidence: app.py:4327 「（会用到显卡，大约几分钟）」; app.py:4545 `c["bt_btn"].click(_settled(self.do_blind), [c["voice"], c["bt_n"], c["quality"]], ...)`; workflows.py:1187 `Narrator(cfg, project, backend, quality=quality, variants=False)`; engine.py:101-104 perfect preset `"max_candidates": 20, ... "force_asr": True`; workflows.py:789 「（大约 5~15 分钟）」; 快速上手.md:76 「找错字（推荐，5 分钟）」; research/时间线.md:866 only training (30.6 min) was ever measured on the teacher's PC.
h1.fix: Replace the time promises with measured numbers or neutral wording. Show the quality used in the blind-test intro and result (or default the blind test to a fixed tier). Log real selection and proofcheck durations so later versions can quote them.

verdict.evidence:
Repro script: （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/text_10/repro.py. It uses the gsv39 python, a temp workspace, the dummy backend, the mfcc encoder and asr engine none. CERChecker loads and SV downloads are stubbed, so nothing touches the network.

1) The 「（大约 5~15 分钟）」 number is real, reachable and was never measured.
- workflows.py:833 reports it right after every GPT-SoVITS training that runs selection. It reaches the progress bar and the 详细过程 log.
- The archived browser run research/过程文件/04_浏览器实测/m28_v18.4引擎与确认/webui.log:57 shows the message on screen. In that run the selection then finished in 3 seconds (22:04:13 to 22:04:16), so the number is a fixed promise and does not adapt to the run.
- `git log -S` and grep trace the number to a spec line in the UX-audit sub-agent output: `_report(progress, 0.88, '训练完成，开始自动挑选最像你的模型（大约 5~15 分钟）')`. It was never a measurement.
- 时间线 and 开发记录 contain only the 30.6-minute training time from the teacher's PC. Her real selection hung before v18.4, and she has not reported since.
- run_train stores `train_minutes` but no selection duration (`t_select` is only used for the failure report), so nothing would ever measure it.
- The workload depends on the setup: checkpoints() gives 4 SoVITS × 3 GPT = 12 models, each tried on 20 validation sentences (DEFAULT_ITEMS=20) plus an ASR check.
- The project already treats unmeasured durations as violations: v18.4 removed 「没测过的『第一次大约 1~2 分钟』」 (开发记录.md:212). So this is the same class of bug, not intended design. It is not listed in research/全面找bug/README.md.

2) The blind test takes the ③ quality without saying so up front. This part is confirmed, but softer than claimed.
- app.py:4545 passes c["quality"] into do_blind, then into build_blind_test(quality=...), then into Narrator(quality=quality, variants=False).
- On an 8 GB card, TIER_QUALITY sets mid to 完美 (adaptive, up to 20 candidates, force_asr).
- The intro at app.py:4327 says only 「（会用到显卡，大约几分钟）」 and never names the tier. My script checked it: "intro mentions quality? False".
- Partly refuted: the finished run does name the tier. The output was 「盲听测试做好了：共 20 段（10 段真人 + 10 段生成），质量「完美」」 for perfect, 「快速」 for fast and 「均衡」 for balanced, shown in the bar and log. The answer JSON also stores "quality".
- 「几分钟」 is vague rather than a specific false number. The dummy backend needed 0.8, 2.4 and 3.2 synth calls per sentence for fast, balanced and perfect; it stops early because MFCC similarity is about 100%. On real hardware perfect can go up to 20 tries, and on first use it may also load or download the ASR model. So it is unverified, but not clearly wrong.

3) 快速上手.md:76 「找错字（推荐，5 分钟）」 was added in commit 083b3a6 (v0.1.6). Back then the step was only looking at red characters. Today it includes a 🔍 pass with a second ASR engine over about 1000 clips, one-click correction and her own review. There is no measurement anywhere. This is the weakest item, since it may be read as a rough estimate of her own effort.

Overall: a real but low-severity breach of rule 7 (不要乱写). Nothing breaks, but the teacher sees a duration promise that no measurement backs.
verdict.fix:
1) workflows.py:833: replace 「（大约 5~15 分钟）」 with neutral wording. Example: 「训练完成，开始自动挑选最像你的模型（要把每个练好的模型都试读一遍，时间取决于模型数量和显卡，进度条会显示预计完成时间）」. run_select already logs 「共 N 个模型 × M 句验证集」.
   Also record the duration, e.g. `info["select_minutes"] = round((time.time() - t_select) / 60.0, 1)`, written next to train_minutes (in models.json / the training summary). A later version can then quote a measured figure.
   What it could break: nothing in tests. No test asserts the string; only the archived m28 log and sub-agent JSON contain it. Any code that dumps info keys gets one extra key.

2) app.py:4327: change the intro to name where the tier comes from. Example: 「（会用到显卡；用的是「③ 生成」页选的质量档，「完美」档最慢，时间取决于句子数和质量档）」. Optionally repeat the tier in the success markdown in do_blind (result["quality"] through QUALITY_SHORT) so it shows outside the log.
   What it could break: browser-test scripts that match the old intro text (none found in tests/). Do not pin the blind test to a fixed tier silently: that would change results the teacher already relies on.

3) 快速上手.md:76: drop 「5 分钟」 (「第 6½ 步　找错字（推荐）」), or replace it with a measured figure. Then regenerate docs/快速上手.pdf (rule 4) and note the change in research/开发记录.md.
   What it could break: only the PDF/markdown sync check, if there is one.
verdict.notes: Low severity and wording-only; it does not affect audio, data or training. The strongest sub-claim is the specific 「5~15 分钟」. The claim that the ⑤ tab never says which quality it used is partly wrong: the final progress message and answer JSON name it (质量「完美」). Only the intro before starting is silent. 「大约几分钟」 is vague rather than a specific unmeasured number. Verified against HEAD ee31ee3; the repo was not modified.

h2.title: One-click correction neither fixes nor suggests a single-character homophone error at the 2nd or 2nd-to-last character, even when the uploaded mother contains the exact sentence
h2.scenario: The teacher uploads her transcript txt and clicks 一键全部文字校正 (once per batch). Several clips have ASR homophone errors one character from the end of the sentence, e.g. '首先我们看一个最简单的栗子。' (mother: 例子) or '今天我们来学习Python里面的列表推到式。' (mother: 推导式).
h2.expected: These are fixed directly (whole sentence ~93% aligned, same pinyin), or at least marked red with a 采用 suggestion. The same error in the last character or 3rd-to-last character is fixed directly.
h2.actual: _strong() requires (left>=2 or at_start) and (right>=2 or at_end). At position N-2 the right context is 1 and at_end is False, and at position 1 the left context is 1, so the prop is not strong. props_to_fixes then drops non-strong single-token near/same props completely. The row gets no fix, no red mark and no suggestion, and the result reports nothing about it. In the e2e run with a GBK/UTF-16 txt mother, 6 of 15 erroneous rows stayed wrong and unflagged; with an id-matched transcripts.csv all 15 were fixed.
h2.evidence: transcript_fix.py:839-843 `return (left >= 2 or at_start) and (right >= 2 or at_end) and left + right >= 2`; transcript_fix.py:1180-1183 `if not p.strong: ... if p.kind in ("near", "same") and p.i2 - p.i1 == 1: continue`. r_textfix_edge.py output: '栗→例 (2nd to last) … props=[('例','same',False)] -> fixes=[]'; '够→构 (last) … -> fixes=[('够','构','direct')]'; '节→结 (2nd to last) … -> fixes=[]'; '栗→例 (3rd to last) … -> direct'; '到→导 (2nd token) … -> fixes=[]'. s8_textfix.py gbk: "rows still wrong after textfix: 6 ['今天我们来学习Python里面的列表推到式。', '首先我们看一个最简单的栗子。', …]".
h2.fix: Treat 'one token from the edge' like the edge in S mode: e.g. (left>=2 or at_start or (left>=1 and i1==1)) and the symmetric rule for the right side. Or require left+right>=2 when coverage is high. At minimum, keep non-strong S-mode props as suggestions (red + 采用) instead of dropping them.

verdict.evidence:
I reproduced this three ways. The repo is unchanged (git status is clean). Scripts are in （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/e2e_3/.

1) End to end (v2_e2e.py). Temp workspace, dummy backend, asr engine none. The manifest holds 10 rows with ASR homophone errors. The teacher uploads a GBK txt with the exact correct sentences, then wf.run_transcript_fix(once=True) runs, which is what the web button does. Result: 5 fixes. These stayed unchanged with suspect=None (no red mark, no 采用 button, not mentioned in the result):
- 「首先我们看一个最简单的栗子。」 (2nd-to-last)
- 「今天我们来学习Python里面的列表推到式。」 (2nd-to-last)
- 「区别在于我们需要同时给出键河值。」 (2nd-to-last)
- 「今添我们来学习Python里面的列表推导式。」 (2nd)
The same sentences with the error at the 1st, last or 3rd-to-last character were fixed directly: 金→今, 紫→子, 退→推, 建→键.

2) Unit level, using the real Reference(builtin + uploaded, own_from=len(builtin)) and the real Lexicon (v1_unit.py). Errors at the 2nd and 2nd-to-last positions produce a prop with strong=False. props_to_fixes then returns []. lex.find also returns [].

3) Position sweep (v3_sweep.py). 120 sentences from the built-in corpus, one same-pinyin homophone injected at each position, with the sentence present in the mother. Direct-fix rates:
- position 0: 67/67
- middle: 1311/1318
- last: 42/42
- position 1: 0/61, all missed with no suggestion
- position N-2: 0/58, all missed with no suggestion

Cause: transcript_fix.py:843 requires (left>=2 or at_start) and (right>=2 or at_end). Position 1 has only 1 character of context on the left and is not at_start; position N-2 has the same problem on the right. So a position with more matched context than the edge counts as weaker than the edge itself. props_to_fixes (lines 1181-1183) then silently drops any non-strong single-token near/same prop.

Why I think this is a bug and not a design choice:
- No test pins this behavior.
- research/全面找bug/README.md does not list it.
- The documented rule (research/文字校正/README.md: "前后各 ≥ 2 个一样的字" plus the edge exception) is clearly meant to treat "context runs to the sentence edge" as enough. The positions one character in from the edge fall through a gap in that rule.

Reachability: the teacher uploads a txt mother, which is a normal, documented flow (only the csv path, matched by id, avoids it), then clicks the button. The button works once per batch, so she gets no second run. About 7.7% of single-character errors land on these two positions.

What limits the impact:
- It never changes text wrongly; it only misses a fix.
- The auto-check engine may still flag the row if it heard it differently.
- For same-pinyin errors the program itself says training is unaffected. Tone-different errors (到/导) do change the training labels.
verdict.fix:
In voicetwin/data/transcript_fix.py:843 (_strong), count context that runs all the way to the sentence edge as enough, since at_start / at_end are just the zero-length case of that:
`n = len(al.exact); return (left >= 2 or left == i1) and (right >= 2 or right == n - i2) and left + right >= 2`

Tested by monkeypatch, without editing the repo:

h3.title: English-teaching notation sb. / sth. splits a sentence into separate TTS calls with a full sentence pause in the middle of the phrase
h3.scenario: A grammar lecture script contains '这个结构是 ask sb. to do sth. 意思是请某人做某事，大家一定要记住。' or 'Remember the pattern: help sb. with sth. It is very common in exams.' (very common notation for this English teacher).
h3.expected: One segment. A period after an abbreviation is not a sentence end.
h3.actual: split_sentences treats 'sb.' followed by a space as a sentence end. The output is '这个结构是 ask sb.' (pause_after='sentence', ~0.78 s from the teacher's profile, sentence-final intonation), then 'to do sth.意思是请某人做某事，大家一定要记住。'. 'help sb.' and 'with sth. It is…' split the same way. A lexicon entry 'sb. => somebody' does not help, because apply_lexicon runs after the split.
h3.evidence: script.py:31-32 ABBREVIATIONS = {"mr","mrs","ms","dr","prof",…,"e.g","i.e","no",…} (no sb/sth/adj/adv/prep/n/v); script.py:169-180 boundary when prev word not in ABBREVIATIONS and next char is space/CJK. r_sb_sth.py output: "'这个结构是 ask sb. to do sth. …' -> 2 segments: '这个结构是 ask sb.' pause_after='sentence' / 'to do sth.意思是请某人做某事，大家一定要记住。'".
h3.fix: Add common teaching abbreviations to ABBREVIATIONS (sb, sth, adj, adv, prep, conj, pron, n, v, vt, vi, art, num, pl, cf). Optionally don't treat '.' as a boundary when the next word starts lowercase.

verdict.evidence:
Reproduced end to end with /tmp/gsv39/bin/python. Script: （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/e2e_4/verify_sb_sth.py. Setup: temp workspace, make_lecture, run_prepare, review_confirm, dummy backend, mfcc encoder, ASR none, network blocked. It runs Narrator.narrate, the same call run_narrate makes from the web UI and CLI.

The script "这个结构是 ask sb. to do sth. 意思是请某人做某事，大家一定要记住。" comes out as 2 TTS calls:
- seg 1: '这个结构是 ask sb.', 0.350-2.095 s
- seg 2: 'to do sth.意思是请某人做某事，大家一定要记住。', 2.802-7.897 s

Between them is a 0.707 s exact-zero gap (16868 samples, max abs 0.0). That is the profile's sentence pause (0.77 s) cut into the middle of "ask sb. to do sth.". The SRT also shows two cues. The log reads "共 2 句 … [1/2] 生成：这个结构是 ask sb.".

Other cases from parse_script:
- 'Remember the pattern: help sb. with sth. It is…' gives 'Remember the pattern: help sb.' (pause sentence) / 'with sth. It is very common in exams.'
- With lexicon [("sb.","somebody"),("sth.","something")] it gets worse: segment 1 becomes '这个结构是 ask somebody。'. apply_lexicon/tts_normalize run per segment after split_sentences (script.py:297 vs :318), and ensure_final_punct appends a 。. So the designed pronunciation mechanism cannot fix it.

Cause: script.py:31-32 ABBREVIATIONS has no sb/sth/adj/adv/n/v. At script.py:169-180, '.' after such a word followed by a space or CJK character is a boundary.

Limits on the claim:
- Very short pieces are rescued by min_units packing. 'ask sb. to do sth.' alone and the 'adj.和 adv.' example stay as one segment. The split happens only when the text before 'sb.' has 6 or more syllables, which is normal in real lecture sentences.
- Known abbreviations (e.g., Mr.) are protected correctly.

Reachability: the teacher teaches English grammar. The core corpus is relative-pronoun lessons, and the handbook mentions 考研英语. sb./sth./adj./n./v. is standard Chinese ELT notation in typed lecture scripts, and any script text pasted into the 生成 tab or given to the CLI goes through parse_script.

- Not intended design or an accepted limitation.
- Not in research/全面找bug/README.md or the third-batch report.
- The only workaround is typing 'somebody' in full, which the teacher would not know to do.
verdict.fix:
Main fix, voicetwin/synth/script.py:31-32: add common teaching abbreviations to ABBREVIATIONS: "sb", "sth", "adj", "adv", "prep", "conj", "pron", "vt", "vi", "n", "v", "art", "num", "pl", "cf", "esp". The existing check at :173 (prev_word.group(1).lower().rstrip('.') in ABBREVIATIONS) then stops the split.

Optional extra at :176: do not treat '.' as a boundary when the next non-space character is a lowercase ASCII letter, e.g. 'sb. to'.

What it could break:
- A real sentence that ends in sb./sth./adj./n./v. and is followed by another sentence on the same line now merges into one TTS call. There is no measured sentence pause inside it and the subtitle cue is longer. chunk_sentence still caps the length at max_units_zh/en. This is the same trade-off already accepted for etc./No.
- Adding the single lowercase letters n/v rarely misfires.
- The optional lowercase rule could join sentences that start with lowercase identifiers (iPhone, code names).

Only the sb./sth. examples inside longer sentences split. Not covered in this repro: whether GPT-SoVITS pronounces 'sb' sensibly. h3.title: Text between '<' and '>' in a lecture script is silently deleted from the audio and subtitles (treated as an HTML tag); lone < and > are also dropped
h3.scenario: The teacher's script contains comparisons or grammar notation, e.g. '考试分数 < 60 分就要补考，分数 > 90 分就是优秀。', '比较级的用法：A > B 的时候用 than', or 'Use <adj> + noun here.'
h3.expected: The content is kept (or the signs are read, e.g. via the lexicon '< => 小于'), or at least the teacher is warned.
h3.actual: clean_markdown removes everything from '<' to the next '>' as an HTML tag. The audio and subtitle say '考试分数 90 分就是优秀。' (the meaning is reversed), and 'Use <adj> + noun' becomes 'Use + noun'. tts_normalize also replaces lone <> with spaces ('A > B' -> 'A B'). The documented lexicon workaround cannot help for the paired case, because clean_markdown runs before apply_lexicon. No warning is given.
h3.evidence: script.py:109 `text = re.sub(r"<(?!break\b)[^>]+>", "", text)  # HTML 标签（保留 <break>）`; script.py:147 `re.sub(r"[\[\]{}【】<>《》]", " ", text)`. r_angle.py output: "display='考试分数  90 分就是优秀。' tts='考试分数 90 分就是优秀。'"; "tts='比较级的用法：A B 的时候用 than，A B 的时候用 less than。'"; "display='Use  + noun here.'".
h3.fix: Only strip real HTML tags, e.g. r"</?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(\s[^<>]*)?/?>" with no spaces or CJK right after '<', and keep <break>. Apply the lexicon before tts_normalize removes <>, or map < / > to 小于 / 大于 (less than / greater than) based on the language.

verdict.evidence:
The claim holds, and the real problem is a bit worse than described. `clean_markdown` (voicetwin/synth/script.py:109) uses `re.sub(r"<(?!break\b)[^>]+>", "", text)`. `[^>]+` also matches newlines, so the first '<' up to the next '>' is deleted, even when that '>' is several paragraphs later. `parse_script` (script.py:263) runs this on every pasted script and on every .txt/.md/.docx upload, before `apply_lexicon` (lines 318/337). Only .srt/.vtt skip it. The engine (`engine.py:832`, `_segments`) and `run_narrate` call it on the text the teacher types in the web UI.

Repro scripts: （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/e2e_5/repro.py and repro_multi.py, run with /tmp/gsv39/bin/python. They use a copied trained workspace, the dummy backend, the mfcc encoder and asr none.
- `parse_script("考试分数 < 60 分就要补考，分数 > 90 分就是优秀。")` gives display '考试分数  90 分就是优秀。' and tts '考试分数 90 分就是优秀。'. The meaning is reversed.
- 'Use <adj> + noun here.' becomes 'Use  + noun here.'
- '如果 x<5 并且 y>3，那么结果是正数。' becomes '如果 x3，那么结果是正数。'
- A .txt upload with the same text gives the same result.
- Adding '< => 小于' and '> => 大于' to the lexicon does not help in the paired cases. It only fixes lone signs: 'A > B' becomes 'A 大于 B'. Without the lexicon, `tts_normalize` (line 147) turns 'A > B' into 'A B' in the audio, while the subtitle keeps the sign.

- repro_multi.py has 4 paragraphs: '<' in paragraph 1 and an ASCII arrow '->' in paragraph 4. The output is 1 segment, '第一段：如果分数  表示变化。最后，下课。'. Paragraphs 2 and 3 disappear from the audio and subtitles with no warning.

It is not in research/全面找bug/README.md, not in the accepted limitations, and no test covers it (tests/test_script.py has no '<' cases). It is reachable whenever the teacher types ASCII '<' or '>' (English input mode, or pasted text), for example score comparisons, 'A > B', '<adj>', or '->' / '=>' arrows in grammar notes.

Severity: medium. Content disappears silently, which matters for an English teacher's scripts. The trigger needs ASCII angle brackets, and a Chinese IME turns them into 《》. The cross-paragraph loss pushes it toward high.
verdict.fix: At voicetwin/synth/script.py:109, strip only real, known HTML tags on a single line. Keep the exclusion: `re.sub(r"\n]*/?>", "", text, flags=re.I)` Also strip HTML comments separately with ``. Do not use a generic letter-start pattern like ``. It still treats '' as a tag and deletes it, and it still matches 'AD'. For lone signs: keep the current behaviour (`tts_normalize` turns '<' and '>' into spaces), because reading them aloud would misread arrows like '->'. Then do one of two things: - (a) Add '< => 小于' and '> => 大于' as commented examples in LEXICON_TEMPLATE (project.py:365). The lexicon already runs before `tts_normalize`, so this works once the paired-tag stripping is fixed. - (b) Have `parse_script` warn in Chinese when a segment's display text still contains '<' or '>'. The brackets themselves become spaces. - Inline HTML split across lines (rare) is no longer stripped. - The PAUSE_RE `` syntax must keep working; the negative lookahead keeps it. - Add tests: '分数 < 60 … > 90' keeps both clauses, 'Use + noun' keeps 'adj', '粗体' still becomes '粗体', `` is still a pause, and a cross-paragraph '<' … '->' keeps every paragraph.

h3.title: A pause written in milliseconds without a unit ([停顿=500]) silently inserts 500 seconds of silence
h3.scenario: A teacher used to SSML or other TTS tools wants half a second and writes '[停顿=500]' (no unit) between two sentences, then generates.
h3.expected: Values that are implausible as seconds (e.g. > 30) are treated as milliseconds, capped, or produce a warning in the result.
h3.actual: The output is 504 s long (8+ minutes of silence) and warnings is []. Huge values (e.g. 15000) would allocate gigabytes in _render's np.zeros.
h3.evidence: script.py:270-274 `sec = float(num) / (1000.0 if unit and unit.lower() in ("ms", "毫秒") else 1.0)`; engine.py:1116-1117 `if isinstance(kind, (int, float)): return float(kind)` (no cap); engine.py:1159 np.zeros(int(total * sr) + 1). r_pause_big.py output: "duration: 504.0 s  warnings: []".
h3.fix: For unitless values > ~20, interpret them as ms or cap at e.g. 10 s, and add a Chinese warning to narrator.warnings ('第 N 句后面的停顿写的是 500 秒，已按 0.5 秒处理').

verdict.evidence:
Reproduced with （临时目录）/hunt4/verify/e2e_8/repro.py. It runs on a copy of the trained dummy workspace (dummy backend, mfcc encoder, ASR off, downloads blocked).

What the parser does (parse_script):
- '第一句。[停顿=500]第二句。' -> pause_after 500.0
- '[停顿=500ms]' -> 0.5
- '<break time="800"/>' with no unit -> 800.0
- '[停顿=2]' -> 2.0

wf.run_narrate(cfg, "老师", "第一句话在这里。[停顿=500]第二句话在这里。") logged "输出响度 -17.6 LUFS，时长 504.0 秒" and returned duration 504.0 with warnings []. The summary line even said "没有需要特别注意的句子".

Code path:
- script.py:270-274 divides by 1000 only when the unit is ms or 毫秒. A number with no unit stays as seconds and is never checked.
- engine.py:1116-1117 `_pause` returns float(kind) with no cap.
- engine.py:1150-1154 adds it to the cursor.
- engine.py:1159 `np.zeros(int(total*sr)+1)` allocates the whole timeline. A typo like [停顿=15000] would mean about 15000 s x 32 kHz x 4 B, roughly 1.9 GB for one array before loudness and export make copies.

The teacher can reach this from the web UI script box (app.py:4240) and from the CLI.

Arguments against it being a bug:
- The documented contract really is seconds. The UI says "`[停顿=1.5]` 指定停顿秒数" and 快速上手.md:140 says "[停顿=2]（停 2 秒）". So 500 s is literally what was typed, and a teacher who follows the docs never hits this.
- Nothing is corrupted. The log does show the 504 s length.

Why I still count it as real: an implausible value gets no guard and no Chinese explanation. That goes against project rule 5 (tell the teacher the reason and what to do). This case is not in research/全面找bug/README.md as fixed, intended, or an accepted limitation. Low severity: it is a UX and robustness hardening issue, not wrong audio for a sensible input.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix in voicetwin/synth/script.py:270-274 (the token loop in parse_script). When `unit` is empty (both the [停顿=N] and the <break time="N"> branches) and the number is larger than a plausible pause (for example > 30), treat it as milliseconds: sec = num/1000. - The `from_files` docstring is about avoiding systematic bias ("打分和校准用同一个标准").
- 教学手册.md §10.5 says short sentences (1.5 s and 3 s) get their own calibration.

| Speech length | Generation judge: median, count below 85% | 鉴别 with uploads: median, count marked 🔴 否 |
|---|---|---|
| 1.3 s | 96.2%, 9/40 | 76.7%, 37/40 |
| 1.7 s | 100.0%, 1/40 | 81.5%, 26/40 |
| 2.5 s | 99.2%, 0/40 | 88.1%, 13/40 |
| 6.0 s | 99.2%, 0/40 | 99.1%, 0/40 |

**Why medium:** the result is a wrong number and a wrong ✅/🔴 verdict shown to the teacher (rule 7). It only appears in the optional upload-originals path of ⑤, and it affects clips with less speech than `full_seconds`. The interpolation reaches up to full length, so most single-sentence clips are biased somewhat. Nothing is lost or corrupted.
verdict.fix:
**Where:** voicetwin/eval/speaker.py, `from_files` (lines 864-946). Compute the short-length standard the same way `calibrate()` does (lines 711-740).

1. **3 or more uploads (`uploaded_loo`):**
   - When `cohort is not None` and the encoder has `prepare` and `embed_prepared`, load each upload with `load_audio(sr=16000)`.
   - Run `speech = enc.prepare(...)`, `e = enc.embed_prepared(speech)` and record `speech.size/16000`.
   - For each `b` in `SHORT_SECONDS` where `speech.size >= int(b*16000)*1.3`, take the center crop. Score it with `JudgeMember(enc, other_cen, {}, cohort).norm_score(...)`, where `other_cen` is the leave-one-out centroid.
   - After `calibration_stats`, if `calib.get("norm") == "asnorm"`, set `calib["g50_short"] = {f"{b:g}": median}` for each bucket with at least 3 values, and `calib["full_seconds"] = median(upload lengths)`.
2. **1-2 uploads (`voice_clips_vs_uploaded`):** do the same in the project-clip loop. Use `prepare` and `embed_prepared` in place of `embed_file`, score crops with `probe.norm_score`, and set `full_seconds` to the median project-clip length.
3. **Refactor:** move the crop logic into a shared helper, e.g. `_embed_with_crops(enc, path, member) -> (emb, seconds, {b: score})`, used by both `calibrate` and `from_files`. That way the two cannot drift apart again.
4. **Test:** add a test like `test_calibration_records_short_standards` (it uses `_LengthNoisyEncoder`) that checks `from_files` returns `g50_short` and `full_seconds`, and that a short clip gets about the same pct from both judges.

**What it could break**
- 鉴别 gets a little slower: up to 2 extra embeddings per uploaded file or calibration clip.
- With too few long uploads, the buckets have fewer than 3 values. The table is then empty and behaviour falls back to the current full-length `g50`. This is safe.
- MFCC, legacy encoders and runs without a cohort are unchanged, because the guard skips cropping. The existing `from_files` tests in tests/test_speaker_filter.py use MFCC and stay valid.
- `signature()` and `info()` do not include `g50_short`, so nothing that depends on them changes.

**Separate gap, not part of this claim:** in `verify_files` the verdict is just `pct >= min_pct`. It ignores `res["short"]`, so clips under 2 s can still show 🔴 否. Generation does not mark those as 不像. This may be worth aligning while fixing the above.
verdict.notes: The real ONNX models were not needed. A synthetic encoder whose embedding noise grows as speech gets shorter shows the effect deterministically. The repro is self-contained: temp workspace, no network, no downloads.

h4.title: 鉴别 marks sentences with under 2 s of speech '🔴 否', against the 不判不像 rule that generation applies
h4.scenario: The teacher clicks 鉴别 with no files selected (the default). It scores the latest lecture's per-sentence clips, which include short sentences such as 「对不对？」 or 「我们来看一下。」.
h4.actual: judge_file returns `short: True` and `seconds`, but verify_files keeps only pct, pcts and sims, and sets pass = pct >= 85. _verify_rows then shows 「🔴 否」 and counts it in 「其中 N 个 ≥ 85%」. For the same score, the generation result shows ⚠️ with 「这一句很短（人声不到 2 秒），「像你本人」的分数只能粗略参考，请用耳朵听一下」. The handbook (10.5) says sentences with under 2 s of speech are not judged 不像. Measured with the real models and the default judge: 20/38 of the teacher's OWN real 0.83 s recordings score below 85%, so they would be shown as 🔴 否 (不像你).
h4.evidence: workflows.py:1356-1359 `res = judge.judge_file(p) ... "pass": bool(pct is not None and pct >= min_pct)}` (res['short'] is ignored). app.py:2293 `mark = "—" if pct is None else ("✅ 是" if passed else "🔴 否")`. t8_verify_short.out: `judge said short = True | verify row pass = False | keys kept: ['file', 'pass', 'path', 'pct', 'pcts', 'rank', 'sims']` / `table row: [1, 'max.wav', 'fake 80.0%（原始 0.600）', '80.0%', 1, '🔴 否']`. t3_short_target.out: `2 words … speech median 0.83s: median 82.9% … pass 85% 47%`.
